Ten thousand frames of nothing.

The log says it is cleaning.
[BEAT] So she cuts open the wall.
The room is there. Exactly as mapped.
Same size. Same doorway. No door.
And the floor is clean.

hooks.text: Delete the photo and it moves closer.
hooks.note: Seven words. Contains the anomaly and the mechanism. Nothing to explain.

hooks.text: There is a photo of a hallway on his phone. He did not take it.
hooks.note: Solid, but spends the first two seconds on setup.

hooks.text: He has deleted the same photograph fourteen times.
hooks.note: Good rhythm, but the impossibility is only implied.

hook_rationale: Hook 1 is the shortest in the entire batch and the only one that states cause and effect together. It also invites the viewer to want him to delete it, which makes the escalation feel like their idea.
voiceover: Delete the photo and it moves closer.
He does not know whose hallway it is.
Grey carpet. One light. A door at the end.
He deletes it. Next morning it is back.
Same hallway. Two steps further in.
He deletes it again. Two more steps.
So he stops. He leaves it alone for a week.
It still moves. Slower. Only on the days he looks at it.
[BEAT] It is not the deleting. It is the attention.
By Friday the door at the end is open.
By Sunday it is a stairwell he recognises.
The last photo is his own front door. From the outside.
He is inside. The door is locked.
And in the corner of the frame, a hand is already holding up a phone.

hooks.text: The camera has already recorded tonight.
hooks.note: Six words, a complete impossibility, zero setup. The strongest short hook in the batch.

hooks.text: At six in the evening, the camera already has tonight's footage.
hooks.note: Clearer, but the clause order buries the strange part until the end.

hooks.text: The camera records one hour of tomorrow. Every single day.
hooks.note: Good, but explains the rule before the viewer has felt the wrongness.

hook_rationale: Hook 1 lands the impossibility inside the first second and leaves a question the viewer cannot answer without the next line. The other two are more informative and less urgent, which is the wrong trade at second zero.
voiceover: The camera has already recorded tonight.
Two in the morning until three. Twenty-four hours early.
Always that hour. Always correct.
He tests it. He moves a chair at two fifteen.
Yesterday's file already shows him doing it.
So he watches the whole hour, over and over.
And then he notices the angle.
The camera is on the ceiling, in the corner.
The footage is from the middle of the wall.
Eye level. Four metres from where the camera is.
[BEAT] There is no camera there.
They open the wall on a Tuesday.
It is an older model. Dust covered. Still powered.
Still recording.
It is not pointed at the room.
It is pointed at the new camera.
